activities.title: Welcome Back: From Fabric to Sewing
activities.summary: Students bridge from Week 7 fabric and tool language into Week 8 sewing-process language by recognizing familiar materials and choosing quick review answers on one compact sewing workspace board.

en.title: Welcome Back: From Fabric to Sewing
en.summary: Look at the sewing workspace and choose the best answer for each quick question.
en.instructions: Look at the sewing workspace board first. Choose the correct answer for each short question about tools, materials, and one preview action word.
success_criteria: I can connect one workspace clue to a tool or material word.
I can remember one Week 7 fabric word while I start Week 8.
I can notice that sewing actions are the new focus this week.

pt.title: Bem-vindo de volta: do tecido para a costura
pt.summary: Observe o espaço de costura e escolha a melhor resposta para cada pergunta rápida.
pt.instructions: Observe primeiro o painel do espaço de costura. Escolha a resposta correta para cada pergunta curta sobre ferramentas, materiais e uma palavra de ação de apresentação.
success_criteria: Eu consigo ligar uma pista do espaço a uma palavra de ferramenta ou material.
Eu consigo lembrar uma palavra de tecido da Semana 7 enquanto começo a Semana 8.
Eu consigo perceber que as ações de costura são o novo foco desta semana.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the opener light and fast. The preview action word should stay clearly secondary to the main selection-based review items.

input.prompt_en: Choose the best review and preview answer for each sewing workspace question.
input.prompt_pt: Escolha a melhor resposta de revisão e apresentação para cada pergunta sobre o espaço de costura.

items.label_en: Which tool is used to cut the fabric?
items.label_pt: Qual ferramenta é usada para cortar o tecido?

items.label_en: Which object helps you measure the fabric?
items.label_pt: Qual objeto ajuda você a medir o tecido?

items.label_en: What material do you see on the table?
items.label_pt: Que material você vê sobre a mesa?
Qual ação de apresentação significa dobrar?

steps.title: Look at the sewing workspace board
steps.student_action_en: Look at the workspace and notice the tools, fabric, and one or two action clues before answering.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe o espaço e perceba as ferramentas, o tecido e uma ou duas pistas de ação antes de responder.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students that last week they described fabric qualities, and this week they begin describing sewing steps.

steps.title: Choose the quick answers
steps.student_action_en: Choose the correct answer for each short review and preview question.
steps.student_action_pt: Escolha a resposta correta para cada pergunta curta de revisão e apresentação.
steps.teacher_action: Keep the pace supportive and quick so the opener feels like a bridge, not a test.

expected_output.description_en: Four quick recognition selections linking one opener board to tools, materials, and the new sewing-action focus.
expected_output.description_pt: Quatro seleções rápidas de reconhecimento ligando um painel inicial a ferramentas, materiais e ao novo foco em ações de costura.

completion_criteria_en: The student identifies the main tools and fabric correctly.
The student recognizes one preview sewing-action word.
The student notices that Week 8 focuses on process language.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno identifica corretamente as principais ferramentas e o tecido.
O aluno reconhece uma palavra de ação de costura de apresentação.
O aluno percebe que a Semana 8 tem foco em linguagem de processo.
checklist_en: I looked carefully at the workspace board.
I used one tool clue and one material clue.
I noticed one new sewing-action word.
checklist_pt: Eu observei com atenção o painel do espaço de costura.
Eu usei uma pista de ferramenta e uma pista de material.
Eu percebi uma nova palavra de ação de costura.
assessment.model_response_en: scissors, measuring tape, fabric, and fold
assessment.model_response_pt: scissors, measuring tape, fabric e fold
common_errors: Choosing a Week 7 material word when the question asks for a tool.
Treating the preview action word like the main task instead of answering the selection questions.
feedback_prompts_en: Look again. Which answer names the tool or material you can see clearly?
feedback_prompts_pt: Observe novamente. Qual resposta nomeia a ferramenta ou o material que você consegue ver com clareza?

support: Let students quietly say the Portuguese support word before choosing the English-linked answer.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one full sentence such as Use scissors to cut the fabric.

extension_options: Say one more sewing action you already know after the opener.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as one compact opener board with four single-choice items. Save the selections only. Keep the preview action clue secondary so the main saved output stays selection.

activities.title: Sewing Action Vocabulary
activities.summary: Students learn the core Week 8 sewing-action words by completing one main keyed matching set, then using a short Portuguese bridge and one support sentence after the core matching.

en.title: Sewing Action Vocabulary
en.summary: Match the sewing actions and sewing words to the correct keyed images.
en.instructions: Match each visible key on the board to the correct English sewing word. After the main matching set, use the short support items for extra practice.
success_criteria: I can match common sewing actions to clear visual examples.
I can match simple sewing-result words such as seam and stitch.
I can use one short support item after the main matching task.

pt.title: Vocabulário de ações de costura
pt.summary: Relacione as ações e palavras de costura às imagens com chave correta.
pt.instructions: Relacione cada chave visível do painel à palavra correta de costura em inglês. Depois do conjunto principal de relação, use os itens curtos de apoio para prática extra.
success_criteria: Eu consigo relacionar ações comuns de costura a exemplos visuais claros.
Eu consigo relacionar palavras simples de resultado de costura como seam e stitch.
Eu consigo usar um item curto de apoio depois da tarefa principal de relação.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the main saved output focused on the keyed matching set. The bridge items should stay clearly secondary and should not replace the main matching path.

steps.teacher_action: Explain that the main task is matching the visible examples to sewing words and that the short bridge items come after the core matching.

steps.teacher_action: Monitor confusion points such as pins versus pin, iron versus press, and seam versus stitch.

steps.title: Use the support items
steps.student_action_en: Complete the short Portuguese bridge and one support sentence after the main matching set.
steps.student_action_pt: Complete a ponte curta com o português e uma frase de apoio depois do conjunto principal de relação.
steps.teacher_action: Keep the support items clearly secondary to the main matching work.

expected_output.description_en: One saved image-word matching set for sewing actions as the main scored output, followed by short support practice.
expected_output.description_pt: Um conjunto salvo de relação imagem-palavra para ações de costura como resultado principal avaliado, seguido por prática curta de apoio.
expected_output.length_or_format: 1 scored image-match set as the main saved output, plus follow-up support practice

completion_criteria_en: The student completes the main sewing-actions matching set.
The student connects clear visual actions to English sewing words.
The student uses one short support item after the main task.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno completa o conjunto principal de relação de ações de costura.
O aluno relaciona ações visuais claras a palavras de costura em inglês.

assessment.model_response_pt: A cut, B fold, C pin, D sew, E press, F measure, G mark, H check, I seam e J stitch

feedback_prompts_en: Look again. Which image shows the action, and which image shows the sewing result?

challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one extra sentence such as Press the hem with an iron.

activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as one main keyed image-matching task with the board visible at all times. Save the matching set as the primary output. Show the translation bridge and one fill-blank support item only after the main matching is complete.

activities.title: Tools + Actions: Use ___ to ___

Eu consigo usar corretamente o padrão Use ___ to ___.

activities.title: Read: Make a Simple Hem Sample
activities.summary: Students read a short hem process, use a fixed visible-key board, and answer clear sequence and detail questions about the process.

en.title: Read: Make a Simple Hem Sample
en.summary: Read the short process and choose the correct answers.
en.instructions: Look at the step board first. Then read the short process text and choose the correct answer for each question.
success_criteria: I can follow a short sewing process in English.
I can connect the text to the correct step key.
I can find the tool or next action from the text.

pt.title: Leitura: faça uma amostra simples de barra
pt.summary: Leia o processo curto e escolha as respostas corretas.
pt.instructions: Observe primeiro o painel das etapas. Depois leia o texto curto do processo e escolha a resposta correta para cada pergunta.
success_criteria: Eu consigo seguir um processo curto de costura em inglês.
Eu consigo ligar o texto à chave correta da etapa.
Eu consigo encontrar no texto a ferramenta ou a próxima ação.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the image keys and the reading text fully aligned. This should stay question-based, not a new drag-reorder interaction.

input.prompt_en: Read the short process and choose the correct answers from the text and image keys.
input.prompt_pt: Leia o processo curto e escolha as respostas corretas com base no texto e nas chaves das imagens.

items.label_pt: Leia o texto do processo.
items.text_en: Make a Simple Hem Sample. First, cut a small rectangle of fabric. Then, fold one edge of the fabric. Next, pin the fold carefully. After that, sew a straight line near the folded edge. Then, remove the pins. Finally, press the hem and check the stitches.
items.text_pt: Make a Simple Hem Sample. First, cut a small rectangle of fabric. Then, fold one edge of the fabric. Next, pin the fold carefully. After that, sew a straight line near the folded edge. Then, remove the pins. Finally, press the hem and check the stitches.

items.label_en: Which step key shows the first action?

activities.title: Listen: Which Step Comes Next?

O aluno mantém a produção no tamanho de uma frase.
checklist_en: I used the word bank carefully.
I checked the sequence words in order.
I completed the short process phrases.
checklist_pt: Eu usei o banco de palavras com atenção.
Eu conferi as palavras de sequência em ordem.
Eu completei as frases curtas de processo.
assessment.model_response_en: First, Then, Next, press, and stitches
assessment.model_response_pt: First, Then, Next, press e stitches
common_errors: Choosing a tool or noun when the sentence needs a sequence word.
Trying to expand the answer into a longer sentence instead of using the controlled blank.
feedback_prompts_en: Which kind of word does this blank need: a sequence word or a process word?
feedback_prompts_pt: Que tipo de palavra esta lacuna precisa: uma palavra de sequência ou uma palavra de processo?

support: Let students say the full sentence quietly before selecting the missing word.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to read the five completed phrases aloud in order.

extension_options: Add one extra process sentence aloud after the fill blanks.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as a tightly controlled fill-blank set with one blank per sentence. Save phrase completions only. Keep the task sentence-length and do not mix in matching or reordering.

activities.title: Simple Sewing Process Card
activities.summary: Students produce the main Week 8 artifact by using the shared gallery as a visual reference and completing a short structured process card with 6 required sentence-frame lines and 1 optional challenge line.

en.title: Simple Sewing Process Card
en.summary: Use the shared process gallery and complete a short process card in English.
en.instructions: Use the shared process gallery from image A to image E as your visual reference. Complete the 6 required sentence-frame lines about the first step, next steps, one tool phrase, and the final check. Add the challenge line only if you want extra practice.
success_criteria: I can complete the required process lines.
I can use sequence words and sewing verbs in short English sentences.
I can revise one line after teacher feedback.
sentence_frames: Optional challenge: This step is important because ___.

pt.title: Cartao de processo simples de costura
pt.summary: Use a galeria compartilhada de processo e complete um cartao curto de processo em ingles.
pt.instructions: Use a galeria compartilhada com as imagens marcadas "image A" a "image E" como referencia visual. Complete as 6 linhas obrigatorias de frases-modelo sobre a primeira etapa, as proximas etapas, uma frase com ferramenta e a verificacao final. Acrescente a linha de desafio apenas se voce quiser pratica extra.
success_criteria: Eu consigo completar as linhas obrigatorias do processo.
Eu consigo usar palavras de sequencia e verbos de costura em frases curtas em ingles.
Eu consigo revisar uma linha depois do feedback do professor.
sentence_frames: Desafio opcional: This step is important because ___.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the task structured and line-based. Do not turn it into a paragraph or word-count task. Students should complete 6 required lines plus 1 optional challenge line only if ready.

input.prompt_en: Use the shared sewing gallery and complete the required process-card lines.
input.prompt_pt: Use a galeria compartilhada de costura e complete as linhas obrigatorias do cartao de processo.

items.label_en: Look at the shared process gallery before you write.
items.label_pt: Observe a galeria compartilhada de processo antes de escrever.
options_en: I can see image A to image E clearly.
options_pt: Eu consigo ver com clareza "image A" a "image E".
items.correct_answer: I can see image A to image E clearly.

items.label_pt: Linha 1: escreva a primeira etapa.
Linha 2: escreva a proxima etapa.

items.label_en: Line 3: Write the next process step.
items.label_pt: Linha 3: escreva a proxima etapa do processo.
Linha 4: acrescente outra etapa do processo.
Linha 5: acrescente uma frase com ferramenta.
Linha 6: acrescente a verificacao final.
Linha de desafio opcional

steps.title: Look at the shared gallery
steps.student_action_en: Look at the shared process gallery from image A to image E before you start writing.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe a galeria compartilhada com as imagens marcadas "image A" a "image E" antes de comecar a escrever.
steps.teacher_action: Keep the shared gallery visible and remind students to use it as a reference, not as a scored choice.

steps.title: Complete the required lines
steps.student_action_en: Complete the 6 required sentence-frame lines about the sequence steps, one tool phrase, and the final check.
steps.student_action_pt: Complete as 6 linhas obrigatorias de frases-modelo sobre as etapas da sequencia, uma frase com ferramenta e a verificacao final.
steps.teacher_action: Keep the writing structured. Encourage students to finish one line at a time.

steps.title: Add the optional challenge only if ready
steps.student_action_en: Add the challenge line only if you want extra practice.
steps.student_action_pt: Acrescente a linha de desafio apenas se você quiser prática extra.
steps.teacher_action: Make it clear that the challenge line is optional, not required.

steps.title: Check and submit
steps.student_action_en: Read your lines again and submit the card for teacher review.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia suas linhas novamente e envie o cartão para revisão do professor.
steps.teacher_action: Prompt students to check tool phrases, sequence order, and final check wording before submission.

expected_output.description_en: A saved Simple Sewing Process Card with 6 required sentence-frame lines and 1 optional challenge line.
expected_output.description_pt: Um Cartao de Processo Simples de Costura salvo com 6 linhas obrigatorias de frases-modelo e 1 linha de desafio opcional.
expected_output.length_or_format: 6 required lines plus 1 optional challenge line

completion_criteria_en: The student completes the 6 required process-card lines.
The student uses sequence words and sewing verbs clearly.
The optional challenge line may be added, but it is not required.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno completa as 6 linhas obrigatorias do cartao de processo.
O aluno usa com clareza palavras de sequencia e verbos de costura.
A linha de desafio opcional pode ser acrescentada, mas nao e obrigatoria.
checklist_en: The card includes the 6 required lines.
The card includes at least four ordered process steps.
The card includes one tool phrase with Use ___ to ___.
The card includes a final check line.
The writing stays line-based, not paragraph-based.
The challenge line is optional only.
checklist_pt: O cartao inclui as 6 linhas obrigatorias.
O cartao inclui pelo menos quatro etapas de processo em ordem.
O cartao inclui uma frase com ferramenta usando Use ___ to ___.
O cartao inclui uma linha de verificacao final.
A escrita continua em linhas, e nao em paragrafo.
A linha de desafio e apenas opcional.
assessment.model_response_en: First, measure the fabric. Then, mark the line. Next, cut the fabric. After that, fold the edge and pin it. Use scissors to cut the fabric. Finally, check the stitches. Optional challenge: This step is important because the line should stay straight.
assessment.model_response_pt: First, measure the fabric. Then, mark the line. Next, cut the fabric. After that, fold the edge and pin it. Use scissors to cut the fabric. Finally, check the stitches. Desafio opcional: This step is important because the line should stay straight.
common_errors: Writing a list of words instead of complete sentence-frame lines.
Forgetting to use a sequence word at the start of a line.
Leaving out to in the tool phrase Use ___ to ___.
Treating the optional challenge line like a required line.
Turning the task into a paragraph instead of separate line fields.
feedback_prompts_en: Please complete one line as a full sentence.
Please check the sequence order again.
Please add one clearer tool phrase.
Please revise one line and submit again.
feedback_prompts_pt: Por favor, complete uma linha como frase inteira.
Por favor, confira novamente a ordem da sequência.
Por favor, acrescente uma frase mais clara com ferramenta.
Por favor, revise uma linha e envie novamente.

support: Let students complete exactly six core lines with a visible word bank and one model line on screen.
challenge: Invite stronger learners to add the optional challenge line with a clear reason linked to quality, order, or tool choice.

extension_options: Turn one line from the card into a speaking note for the teacher session.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as a teacher-reviewed structured writing card with the shared gallery visible and separate saved line fields, not a paragraph text box. Keep 6 lines required, 1 challenge line optional, and show the teacher the checklist, common errors, feedback prompts, and return-for-revision workflow.

activities.title: Review and Improve: Clear Process Sentences
activities.summary: Students improve short sewing-process sentences by correcting one clear error at a time and submitting two corrected sentences for app checking.

en.title: Review and Improve: Clear Process Sentences
en.summary: Read each short sentence, find the mistake, and write the corrected sentence.
en.instructions: Look at one correction card at a time. Read the short sewing sentence, find the mistake, and rewrite the sentence correctly. Write two corrected sentences.
success_criteria: I can notice one mistake in a short process sentence.
I can rewrite the sentence clearly in English.
I can keep my correction short and accurate.

pt.title: Reveja e melhore: frases claras de processo
pt.summary: Leia cada frase curta, encontre o erro e escreva a frase corrigida.
pt.instructions: Observe um cartao de correcao por vez. Leia a frase curta de costura, encontre o erro e reescreva a frase corretamente. Escreva duas frases corrigidas.
success_criteria: Eu consigo perceber um erro em uma frase curta de processo.
Eu consigo reescrever a frase com clareza em ingles.
Eu consigo manter minha correcao curta e correta.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the task focused on visible sentence correction only. Students should correct two short sentences and the app should check against accepted answers, not teacher judgment.

input.prompt_pt: Corrija as frases curtas de processo de costura.

items.label_pt: Cartao de correcao 1
items.student_prompt_en: Rewrite the sentence with the correct sequence punctuation and object.
items.student_prompt_pt: Reescreva a frase com a pontuacao correta da sequencia e com o objeto correto.

items.label_pt: Cartao de correcao 2
items.student_prompt_en: Rewrite the sentence with the correct tool phrase.
items.student_prompt_pt: Reescreva a frase com a expressao correta de ferramenta.
accepted_answers: Use scissors to cut the fabric.
Use the scissors to cut the fabric.

steps.title: Read the first correction card
steps.student_action_en: Read the first short sentence and notice the sequence problem.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia a primeira frase curta e perceba o problema de sequencia e de completude.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students to compare the sentence with the frame shown on the card.

steps.title: Rewrite the corrected sentence
steps.student_action_en: Write the corrected sentence for the first card, then repeat the process for the second card.
steps.student_action_pt: Escreva a frase corrigida do primeiro cartao e depois repita o processo no segundo cartao.
steps.teacher_action: Encourage short accurate rewrites instead of longer explanations.

steps.title: Check and submit
steps.student_action_en: Read both corrected sentences again and submit them.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia novamente as duas frases corrigidas e envie as respostas.
steps.teacher_action: Point out that the task checks exact sentence correction, not extra details.

expected_output.description_en: Two corrected sewing-process sentences checked by the app.
expected_output.description_pt: Duas frases corrigidas de processo de costura verificadas pelo app.

completion_criteria_en: The student rewrites both sentences correctly.
The student uses the visible sentence frame or tool phrase correctly.
The student keeps each correction short and complete.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno reescreve as duas frases corretamente.
O aluno usa corretamente a estrutura visivel da frase ou a expressao com ferramenta.
O aluno mantem cada correcao curta e completa.
checklist_en: I fixed the sequence frame in sentence 1.
I used Use ___ to ___ correctly in sentence 2.
I submitted two complete corrected sentences.
checklist_pt: Eu corrigi a estrutura de sequencia na frase 1.
Eu usei Use ___ to ___ corretamente na frase 2.
Eu enviei duas frases corrigidas completas.
assessment.model_response_en: Then, cut the fabric carefully. Use scissors to cut the fabric.
assessment.model_response_pt: Then, cut the fabric carefully. Use scissors to cut the fabric.
common_errors: Leaving out the object in the first correction.
Leaving out to in the tool phrase.
Adding extra ideas that are not needed for the correction.
feedback_prompts_en: Which sequence word should start this sentence?
Does your tool phrase include to after the tool?
feedback_prompts_pt: Qual objeto esta faltando nesta frase?
Sua frase com ferramenta inclui to depois da ferramenta?

support: Let students reread the visible sentence frame before they type the correction.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to explain orally why each corrected sentence is better.

extension_options: Turn one corrected sentence into a model line for the speaking task.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render one correction card at a time. Save two corrected sentences as the main output and check them against explicit accepted answers only.

activities.title: Teacher Session: Explain the Steps
activities.summary: Students use the shared process board and their writing card to explain a short sewing sequence aloud in a teacher-observed speaking routine.

en.title: Teacher Session: Explain the Steps
en.summary: Look at the process board and explain the steps aloud in short English sentences.
en.instructions: Use the process board and your process card. Say 5 to 6 short steps aloud. Use sequence words and at least one tool phrase.
success_criteria: I can say the steps in order.
I can use short clear sewing words in English.
I can include at least one tool phrase.

pt.title: Sessao com o professor: explique as etapas
pt.summary: Observe o painel de processo e explique as etapas em voz alta com frases curtas em ingles.
pt.instructions: Use o painel de processo e o seu cartao de processo. Diga 5 a 6 etapas curtas em voz alta. Use palavras de sequencia e pelo menos uma frase com ferramenta.
success_criteria: Eu consigo dizer as etapas em ordem.
Eu consigo usar palavras curtas e claras de costura em ingles.
Eu consigo incluir pelo menos uma frase com ferramenta.

activities.teacher_instructions: This is a teacher-observed speaking task only. Do not require recording, upload, or automated scoring. Keep the output scaffolded and short by using the process board and the student's card as speaking supports.

input.prompt_en: Use the board and your process card to explain the simple sewing process aloud.
input.prompt_pt: Use o painel e o seu cartao de processo para explicar em voz alta o processo simples de costura.

items.label_pt: Tarefa de fala
items.prompt_en: Explain the steps from image A to image E in 5 to 6 short sentences.
items.prompt_pt: Explique as etapas da sequencia marcada de "image A" a "image E" em 5 a 6 frases curtas.

steps.title: Review the board and card
steps.student_action_en: Look at the process board and your process card before you speak.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe o painel de processo e o seu cartao de processo antes de falar.
steps.teacher_action: Give students a short preparation moment with the visible sequence frames.

steps.title: Explain the steps aloud
steps.student_action_en: Say 5 to 6 short process steps aloud in order and include one tool phrase.
steps.student_action_pt: Diga em voz alta 5 a 6 etapas curtas de processo em ordem e inclua uma frase com ferramenta.
steps.teacher_action: Observe for clarity, sequence words, tool phrase use, and key pronunciation targets.

steps.title: Close with brief feedback
steps.student_action_en: Listen to one short teacher comment about your speaking.
steps.student_action_pt: Escute um comentario curto do professor sobre a sua fala.
steps.teacher_action: Give one strength and one next-step note. Keep the feedback brief and supportive.

expected_output.description_en: One teacher-observed spoken explanation of a simple sewing process with 5 to 6 short steps.
expected_output.description_pt: Uma explicacao oral observada pelo professor sobre um processo simples de costura com 5 a 6 etapas curtas.

completion_criteria_en: The student explains the steps in a clear order.
The student uses sequence words and at least one tool phrase.
The student completes a short spoken explanation without recording or upload.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno explica as etapas em uma ordem clara.
O aluno usa palavras de sequencia e pelo menos uma frase com ferramenta.
O aluno completa uma explicacao oral curta sem gravacao nem envio.
checklist_en: The student says 5 to 6 short steps.
The student uses at least one tool phrase.
The student uses understandable pronunciation for key sewing words.
The student stays on the visible process path.
checklist_pt: O aluno diz 5 a 6 etapas curtas.
O aluno usa pelo menos uma frase com ferramenta.
O aluno usa pronuncia compreensivel para palavras-chave de costura.
O aluno permanece no caminho de processo visivel.
assessment.model_response_en: First, measure the fabric. Then, mark the line. Next, cut the fabric. After that, fold the edge and pin it. Use scissors to cut the fabric. Finally, check the stitches.
assessment.model_response_pt: First, measure the fabric. Then, mark the line. Next, cut the fabric. After that, fold the edge and pin it. Use scissors to cut the fabric. Finally, check the stitches.
common_errors: Skipping sequence words.
Switching the order of the visible process steps.
Speaking in single words instead of short sentences.
Trying to record instead of speaking live to the teacher.
feedback_prompts_en: Please say the steps again with sequence words.
Please add one tool phrase to your explanation.
Please keep your sentences short and clear.
feedback_prompts_pt: Por favor, diga novamente as etapas com palavras de sequencia.
Por favor, acrescente uma frase com ferramenta a sua explicacao.
Por favor, mantenha suas frases curtas e claras.

support: Let students keep the process card visible while they speak.
challenge: Invite stronger learners to add one reason sentence after the final step.

extension_options: Pair students for one extra rehearsal before the next live explanation.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Show the speaking frame and image board as supports, but store only teacher observation/completion data. Do not add recording, upload, or automated speech scoring.
